name: Dallas
intro: Dallas’s stars come from the MICHELIN Guide Texas, first published in 2024. Goldee’s Bar-B-Q, the starred barbecue joint in Fort Worth, is on the Texas page. Prices are in US dollars, per person before tax and tip (or the service charge some restaurants add), checked October 2026.

localNote.q: How do you book a Michelin star restaurant in Dallas?
localNote.a: Dallas has two starred restaurants, booked in different ways. {r:mamani}, Christophe De Lellis’s French-inspired restaurant, takes tables on OpenTable. {r:tatsu-dallas}, Tatsuya Sekiguchi’s Edomae sushi counter in the Continental Gin Building, sells its omakase on Tock as a prepaid ticket, refunded only if you cancel at least five days ahead.

localNote.q: When do tables open at Tatsu Dallas?
localNote.a: Twice a month, on the 1st and the 15th at 8am Central time, for the dates starting two weeks later: on 15 September, the first half of October. It serves two seatings a night, Tuesday to Saturday, so seats go quickly.

localNote.q: How much should you tip in Dallas?
localNote.a: At Tatsu, nothing: in keeping with Japanese custom it adds an 18% service charge instead of taking tips, and it asks guests to go light on perfume. At Mamani, tip 18–22% of the bill before tax, as usual in the US. Sales tax in Dallas is 8.25% on top of both.
